entities.summary: Michelle Karvinen is a Danish-Finnish ice hockey player for the Vancouver Goldeneyes of the Professional Women's Hockey League (PWHL) and member of the Finnish national team. Karvinen has been described as "the world's best technical player" and she is considered one of the best currently active ice hockey forwards. With the Finnish national team, she has won three Olympic bronze medals and six IIHF Women's World Championship medals, five bronze and one silver.
